REDCapCDMSTAT is one engine for clinical **data management** and
**statistical analysis** on REDCap studies. This page takes you from
installation to a first query, a first Table 1 and a reproducible script in
a few minutes, using the built-in simulated trial.

## Install

```r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("neu-data/REDCapCDMSTAT/REDCapCDMSTAT")
```

## Open the demo study

The demo is a simulated two-arm randomised trial: 120 subjects at four sites,
three visits (baseline, week 12, week 24), a repeating adverse-event form,
and a handful of planted data problems, so every part of the pipeline has
something to find.

```{r}
library(REDCapCDMSTAT)
nx <- cdmstat_demo(dir = file.path(tempdir(), "get-started"), reset = TRUE, actor = "dana")
nx
```

`nx` is a [CDMSTAT] engine object. Its methods cover the whole workflow; see
`?CDMSTAT` for the full list.

## Find the data problems

Rules come from the **live data dictionary** (ranges, required fields,
values hidden by branching logic, stale calculated fields) plus any custom
rules you add:

```{r}
issues <- nx$validate()
issues[, c("severity", "rule", "record_id", "event", "field", "value")]
```

Turn them into tracked queries:

```{r}
nx$raise_queries()
head(nx$queries()[, c("record_id", "field", "message", "status")], 4)
```

Fixing a value in REDCap and syncing resolves the matching query
automatically.

## A first Table 1

The treatment arm and the baseline variables are detected from the
dictionary, and each variable's test is chosen from the data. The
`rationale` column says why:

```{r}
t1 <- nx$table_one()
t1[t1$level %in% c("", "mean (SD)", "median [IQR]"), c("label", "Drug A", "Placebo", "p_value", "test")]
```

## A reproducible script

Every analytic step is logged as R code that replays the session, so a
point-and-click session in the app hands the statistician a script:

```{r}
cat(tail(strsplit(nx$script(), "\n")[[1]], 8), sep = "\n")
```
